# Intent-First PR Template

Use this template to align changes with the Intent-First Handbook.

## Intent Summary
What outcome does this PR deliver? Who benefits and how?

## Context Discovery
- Related code/docs/specs searched:
- Adjacent systems (UI/Backend/DB/Infra) touched:
- History reviewed (issues/PRs/commits/notes):

## Value, Risk, Effort
- User value: High / Medium / Low — why
- Business value: High / Medium / Low — why
- Technical effort: Hours / Days / Weeks (estimate)
- Operational risk: Low / Medium / High (monitoring, cost, security, compliance)

## Decision & Scope
- Action: Complete now (MVP) | Plan later | Tech/Test Debt | Remove (approval)
- Scope in this PR (MVP):
- Deferred enhancements (linked issues):

## MVP Tests
- [ ] Happy path covered
- [ ] One high-impact failure covered
- [ ] Security/data/compliance constraint covered (if applicable)

## Traceability
- Specs / API YAMLs / Schemas:
- ADR link (if applicable):
- Dashboards/alerts (if updated):

## Rollout
- Feature flags / kill-switch:
- Migrations/backfills:
- Post-deploy checks:

Reference: `intent_first_handbook.md`, `docs/engineering/templates/INTENT_FIRST_CHECKLIST.md`
